story_title: Event Coordinator Lead: Rename Role and View Assignments

acceptance_criteria.text: The role previously shown as "Event Operations Manager" is shown as "Event Coordinator Lead" everywhere it appears in the system, including the top bar, navigation, dashboards and the Assignments screen. Existing accounts, permissions and records are unchanged.
The Lead can view the unassigned queue and assign and reassign events, as built in SPM-30.
The Lead cannot perform a Coordinator's planning actions (reviewing a request, booking venues, managing equipment, confirming an event).
The Lead can view a list of Event Coordinators, each with the number of active events assigned to them.
The Lead can view all active events, each showing its assigned Coordinator, status, client organisation and event date.
An active event is one that is not Draft, Rejected, Withdrawn, Cancelled or Completed.
The Lead can filter the events by assigned Coordinator and by status.
The Lead can open an event from the list to view its information.
The Lead can start a reassignment from the list, using the reassignment built in SPM-30.
Given a Coordinator has no active events, when the list is shown, then that Coordinator still appears, with a count of zero.
The list reflects assignments and reassignments as they are made.
Event Coordinators, Venue Staff, Technical Support Staff, Safety Officers and external users cannot access this view.

test_cases.title: The Event Operations Manager is shown as the Event Coordinator Lead, with the same account, sidebar and Assignments screen as before
test_cases.preconditions:
npm run fixtures:spm84 has been run.
Grace Lim's account (grace.lim@connectsphere.com) is the role previously called Event Operations Manager.
Logged out.
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 1: Login succeeds with the existing password. The top bar shows 'Grace Lim' and the role 'Event Coordinator Lead' - not 'Operations Manager'. The sidebar shows Dashboard, Assignments, All Events, Venues and Notifications, as before.
Step 2: The 'Assignments' page opens with three tabs: 'Awaiting assignment', 'Active events' and 'Coordinators'. 'Operations Manager' does not appear anywhere on the page.
Step 3: The All Events list opens as before, with no 'Operations Manager' wording.

npm run fixtures:spm84 has been run. It creates four coordinator accounts of SPM-84's own:

- Benjamin Lau: SPM84 Riverside Launch (Confirmed)
- Clara Tay: SPM84 Past Seminar (Completed) only
- Dennis Ho: account deactivated, still assigned SPM84 Inherited Workshop (Planning)
Logged in as the Event Coordinator Lead, Grace Lim (grace.lim@connectsphere.com / password123).
test_cases.test_data: Coordinators: Aisha Karim (3 active), Benjamin Lau (1), Clara Tay (0), Dennis Ho (1, account inactive)
test_cases.expected_result: Step 2: A table lists every Event Coordinator by name, A to Z, with an 'Active events' column. Aisha Karim shows 3 (her Completed, Cancelled, Rejected and Withdrawn events are not counted). Benjamin Lau shows 1. Clara Tay is listed with 0. Dennis Ho shows 1 and is labelled 'Account inactive'. The base coordinators (e.g. Daniel Tan, Priya Raj) are listed too.

test_cases.title: The Active events tab, filtered to one coordinator, shows only their active events with coordinator, status, client and date, and each opens its event
test_cases.preconditions:
npm run fixtures:spm84 has been run (Aisha Karim has three active and four inactive SPM84 events, all for the client Meridian Financial Group).
Logged in as the Event Coordinator Lead, Grace Lim (grace.lim@connectsphere.com / password123).
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 2: A table of active events opens with the columns Event, Client, When, Status, Coordinator and 'Reassign to', and the filters 'Coordinator' (set to 'Any coordinator') and 'Status' (set to 'Any status').
Step 3: Exactly three rows remain: 'SPM84 Harbour Gala' (Planning, 9 Nov 2027), 'SPM84 Orchard Forum' (Under review, 11 Nov 2027) and 'SPM84 Postponed Retreat' (Postponed, 16 Nov 2027), each with Client 'Meridian Financial Group' and Coordinator 'Aisha Karim'. Step 4: The event's Overview opens with the title 'SPM84 Harbour Gala', the status 'Planning', Coordinator 'Aisha Karim' and Company 'Meridian Financial Group', and a 'Change coordinator' card.

test_cases.title: The Coordinator and Status filters narrow the list together, offer only active statuses, survive a reload, say when nothing matches, and can show events with no coordinator
test_cases.preconditions:
npm run fixtures:spm84 has been run (Aisha Karim has 'SPM84 Harbour Gala' in Planning; Benjamin Lau has only a Confirmed event; 'SPM84 Unassigned Request' is Submitted with no coordinator).
Logged in as the Event Coordinator Lead, Grace Lim (grace.lim@connectsphere.com / password123).
test_cases.test_data: Aisha Karim + Planning; Benjamin Lau + Planning (no match); Not yet assigned
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 4: The list offers 'Any status', then Submitted, Under review, Approved, Planning, Safety review, Safety approved, Confirmed and Postponed - no Draft, Rejected, Withdrawn, Cancelled or Completed.
Step 5: Only 'SPM84 Harbour Gala' (Planning, Aisha Karim) is listed.
Step 6: The page reopens on the 'Active events' tab with 'Aisha Karim' and 'Planning' still chosen, and still only 'SPM84 Harbour Gala' listed.

test_cases.expected_result:

open_questions: RESOLVED 2026-10-20 (agreed by the team, all recommendations followed): Where the view lives - the existing Assignments page (S-28, /assignments) gets three tabs: 'Awaiting assignment' (unchanged, /assignments), 'Active events' (/assignments?view=active, replacing SPM-30's 'Assigned' tab and adding active events with no coordinator) and 'Coordinators' (/assignments?view=coordinators). The old address /assignments?view=assigned opens 'Active events'.

RESOLVED 2026-10-20 (agreed by the team, all recommendations followed): Active events tab - columns Event (title link to the Overview, reference under it), Client, When, Status, Coordinator ('Not yet assigned' when none), and 'Reassign to' (or 'Assign to' for an event with no coordinator, using SPM-30's control). Filters 'Coordinator' ('Any coordinator', 'Not yet assigned', then each coordinator A to Z) and 'Status' ('Any status', then each active status). Both are kept in the address (?coordinator=<id>&status=<key>), so a reload or a shared link keeps them. Empty: 'No active events match these filters' / 'Try another coordinator or status.'; with no filters and no events: 'No active events' / 'Events appear here once an organiser submits a request.' Sorted by event date, earliest first. Subtitle: 'Every active event and its coordinator. Reassign one when responsibilities or availability change.'

RESOLVED 2026-10-20 (agreed by the team, all recommendations followed): Coordinators tab - columns Coordinator and 'Active events', A to Z by name. Each name links to the Active events tab filtered to that coordinator. A coordinator with no active events is listed with 0 (AC10). A deactivated coordinator is listed only while they still hold an active event, labelled 'Account inactive'; they are not offered in 'Assign to' / 'Reassign to' (SPM-30). Subtitle: 'Every Event Coordinator and the number of active events assigned to them.'

RESOLVED 2026-10-20 (agreed by the team, all recommendations followed): Active means AC6 literally - Submitted, Under review, Approved, Planning, Safety review, Safety approved, Confirmed and Postponed. A Submitted event has no coordinator, so it appears under 'Not yet assigned' and counts toward nobody.

RESOLVED 2026-10-20 (agreed by the team, all recommendations followed): The rename (AC1) - ROLE_LABELS shows 'Event Coordinator Lead' (top bar, wherever a role name is shown). The Assignments refusal reads 'Assigning coordinators is the Event Coordinator Lead's role.'; the Review Queue's empty state 'Requests appear here once the Event Coordinator Lead assigns them to you.'; the assign API's refusal 'Only the Event Coordinator Lead can assign coordinators'. The stored role key (ops_manager), accounts, permissions and records are unchanged. The sidebar link stays 'Assignments'; the dashboard is unchanged (it never named the role).

RESOLVED 2026-10-20 (agreed by the team, all recommendations followed): AC11 - the lists reload after every assign or reassign made on the screen, and on every visit. No live push: a change made in another browser shows on the next load, like the rest of the app.

RESOLVED 2026-10-20 (agreed by the team, all recommendations followed): Other stories' test cases that name the role 'Operations Manager' on screen (listed under Pending in docs/test-cases/DECOMMISSIONED.md) are set to Updated, with a v2 line, in the same PR, as docs/test-cases/README.md requires.

RESOLVED 2026-10-20 (agreed by the team, all recommendations followed): Fixtures (scripts/seed-spm84.ts, written with the code) - four coordinator accounts of SPM-84's own, password password123: Aisha Karim (aisha.karim@connectsphere.com), Benjamin Lau (benjamin.lau@), Clara Tay (clara.tay@), Dennis Ho (dennis.ho@, deactivated). Events for client Meridian Financial Group (organiser Rachel Ng), November 2027: SPM84 Harbour Gala (Planning, 9 Nov), SPM84 Orchard Forum (Under review, 11 Nov), SPM84 Postponed Retreat (Postponed, 16 Nov), SPM84 Closed Showcase (Completed), SPM84 Called Off Expo (Cancelled), SPM84 Rejected Request (Rejected), SPM84 Withdrawn Request (Withdrawn) - all Aisha's; SPM84 Riverside Launch (Confirmed, Benjamin); SPM84 Past Seminar (Completed, Clara); SPM84 Inherited Workshop (Planning, Dennis); SPM84 Unassigned Request (Submitted, no coordinator). Counts are only ever checked for these accounts, since other stories' fixtures change the base coordinators' counts.
RESOLVED 2026-10-20: Notifying users of an assignment or reassignment is Receive Event Notifications (SPM-53); SPM-30 already notifies both coordinators. No case here.
RESOLVED 2026-10-20: The unassigned queue, assign and reassign are SPM-30's and are not rebuilt (SPM-83 folded into SPM-84). TC08 and TC09 check them from the Lead's new tabs only.
